blocks.text: Match preview: Australia face England in 3rd T20I (T20) on Fri, 27 Nov, 2026, 1:45 pm at The Gabba Brisbane. Full pitch report, weather forecast, and squad details below.
Pace and bounce typical of Australian wickets; good carry for fast bowlers.
Heavy drizzle · High 27°C / Low 20°C · Rain: 6.1 mm · Wind: up to 16 km/h. Rain likely — DLS may apply; favour bowlers who hit the deck and teams with depth.
International playing XI is announced at the toss. Check back on match day for confirmed line-ups.
